name: Cruise Line Operators
summary: Cruise line operators represent a cyclical consumer discretionary bet on post-pandemic travel recovery and premium leisure experiences. The thesis examines pricing power amid high fixed costs, fuel price sensitivity, and debt management from pandemic-era recapitalizations. Operators compete on ship quality, itinerary diversity, and onboard monetization while sharing exposure to economic sensitivity and weather-related disruptions.

relationships.note: Disney Cruise Line competes with Royal Caribbean in family segment

valuation.erp_basis: S&P 500 ERP plus 1pp for cruise industry cyclicality and fuel cost volatility
valuation.terminal_growth_basis: Long-term travel industry growth at GDP+0.2pp driven by experiential spending
